[Hey brother, you spoke next-level English. Where did you learn this?] Speaker B: Sir, zamana English ka hai. nahi aati to log izzat nahi dete. Ab aap khud hi dekh lo, jab maine English boli, tab aap thodi aur izzat se baat karne lage. isiliye har kisi ko English seekhna zaroori ho gaya hai. Jab bhi time milta hai, reels mein time waste karne ke bajay yahi dekh leta hoon. Aur seekhne ke baad ismein ek Reeva naam ki English teacher bhi hain, usse dost ki tarah English mein baat karta hoon. I practice only 10 to 15 minutes. It's every day. But see how good my English is. [Sir, it's the era of English. If you don't know it, people don't respect you. Now look at yourself, when I spoke English, you started talking with more respect. summary: A man asks a utility worker when the power will return, and is surprised when the worker replies in fluent English. The worker explains that English is essential for respect and that he learns it daily using short videos and an AI tutor on the PW Talk app. The ad ends with a call to download the app on Google Play.
